build_mnasnet_backbone: build a MNASNetBackbone instance that extracts multi-scale feature maps p2 through p6 from input images
build_mnasnet_fpn_backbone: build a detectron2 FPN backbone using MNASNet1_0 as the bottom-up feature extractor with ImageNet pretrained weights
run_MNASNetBackbone_forward: run the MNASNetBackbone forward pass to extract feature pyramid levels p2 to p6 from an input tensor
review_MNASNetBackbone_forward: review the MNASNetBackbone forward method that slices base layers and applies max pooling to produce p6
refactor_build_mnasnet_fpn_backbone: refactor the build_mnasnet_fpn_backbone function to customize FPN in_features or out_channels from the config
